articles.summary: Our localization workflow generated roughly 16 mechanical PRs a week that no one wanted to make. We built a GitHub App during a hackathon to automate the entire cycle — under 900 lines of JavaScript, no HTTP framework, just Node's built-in http module and Octokit. Here's how it works and enough code for you to build your own.
articles.title: How a GitHub App Saved Us Hours of Manual Effort

articles.summary: Network Flow Lens is a self-service diagnostics tool that gives developers instant visibility into physical network infrastructure. It validates firewall policies, traces paths, and identifies active errors in under a minute, replacing hours of cross-team troubleshooting.
articles.title: Network Flow Lens Provides Real-Time Network Diagnostics at Your Fingertips

articles.summary: Five engineers. Over 500 production applications. A user base doubling every year. Here's how the Katana platform team put AI at the front of its support workflow, automated more than 80% of support requests, turned the assistant into a feedback engine for continuous improvement, and freed the team to focus on the problems that need human expertise.
articles.title: How We Scaled Platform Support 10x Without Scaling the Team
